hypothesis.direction: Long gap-up accepted sessions; short gap-down accepted sessions.
hypothesis.entry_event: First completed bar after 09:30 acceptance confirmation.
hypothesis.hypothesis_name: Gap acceptance continuation after completed first-15-minute confirmation
hypothesis.invalidation: Price closes back through prior close before entry or opening range midpoint fails acceptance.
hypothesis.known_prior_research: Related to opening drive and ORB, but distinct because trigger is prior-close gap acceptance after first-15-minute confirmation, not opening-range breakout/retest.
hypothesis.legal_entry_timestamp: 09:31 IST or first next completed one-minute timestamp after acceptance.
hypothesis.material_distinction_from_prior_work: Uses overnight inventory acceptance relative to prior close, not generic ORB breakout or raw opening impulse.
hypothesis.negative_expectation_falsifier: No positive WFA mean, fewer than 4 positive folds, or controls match/exceed signal.
hypothesis.parameter_ownership: session mechanics and round completed-bar structure

parameter_units.minimum_abs_gap_bps: basis points from prior close to open

hypothesis.participants_or_behavior: Overnight inventory adjustment, index futures hedging, and intraday trend followers adding after the first accepted opening range.
hypothesis.persistence_rationale: Opening auction displacement often forces benchmark and intraday participants to transact in the gap direction when price stays outside the prior close area.
hypothesis.primary_outcome: Direction-normalized underlying return from legal entry close to +30 completed minutes, clipped at session end.
hypothesis.required_data: Underlying one-minute OHLC candles for NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, SENSEX; prior-session close; completed first 15 one-minute bars.
setup_state_machine: MEASURE gap from prior close to session open
ACCEPT if 09:30 close remains beyond 50% of gap in gap direction and above/below opening range midpoint
EMIT once at first legal bar after acceptance
hypothesis.single_emission_rule: At most one candidate per symbol-session.
hypothesis.structural_premise: A directional overnight gap that is accepted after the opening range reflects inventory repricing rather than immediate mean reversion.
